1  JUDGMENT

The Criminal Appeal has been filed as against the order of dismissal of Bail application in Crl.MP.No. 512 of 2024 dated 10.04.2024 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, Special Court for trial of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities Amendment Act) at Cuddalore -District 2.

Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the appellant is innocent and he was falsely implicated in a case registered for the offence under Sections417, 376(2)(n), 313, 294(b) , 323 of IPC r/w 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(1)(w)(i) and 3(2)(v)of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act 1989 in Crime No.3 of 2024 and remanded to judicial custody on 28.03.2024.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He further submitted that the appellant is confined in Central Prison, Cuddalore for a period of more than 76 days.
Hence, he prays this Court for grant of bail to the appellant.

3. On the above contention, this Court heard the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents 1 & 2.
4.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and also the period of incarceration, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the appellant.
